ConfirmResetToDefaults: Are you sure you want to reset all store settings to defaults?
LogoPathHint: Path to the logo image file
Online_Connect_cloud_error: The cloud had a problem. Try again in a moment.
Online_Connect_cloud_insecure_url: This link does not start with https:// so it cannot be trusted. Ask your provider for a new link.
Online_Connect_cloud_unreachable: Could not reach the cloud. Check this computer's internet connection and try again.
Online_Connect_enroll_code_expired: This link has expired. Ask your provider for a new one.
Online_Connect_enroll_code_invalid: This link is not valid. Check that you copied all of it, or ask for a new one.
Online_Connect_enroll_code_used: This link was already used. Ask your provider for a new one.
Online_Connect_enroll_link_invalid: That doesn't look like a NexPOS Online link. Copy the whole link you were sent and paste it again.
Online_Connect_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
Online_Connect_site_disabled: This connection has been disabled. Contact your provider.
Online_DisconnectMessage: This till stops sending data to the cloud. Nothing on this till is deleted, and the cloud keeps the copy it already has. To connect again you will need a new link.
Online_Intro: Online keeps a copy of your shop in the cloud, so the owner can check sales, stock and debts from a phone. This till keeps working without internet, as always.
Online_OfflineNote: Selling never waits for Online. If the internet is down, sales are saved here and sent later.
Online_Problem_network: Can't reach the cloud right now. Your sales are safe here and will be sent automatically when the connection is back.
Online_Problem_other: The cloud could not accept the latest changes. It will try again by itself. If this stays, tell your provider.
Online_Problem_schemaNewer: This NexPOS is newer than the cloud service. Your provider needs to update the cloud. Nothing is lost.
Online_Problem_sealKey: The shop's key could not be opened, so nothing is being sent. Your sales are safe here. Tell your provider.
Online_Problem_sealKeyMissing: This PC does not have your key, so nothing is being sent. Enter the recovery code from your slip.
Online_Problem_subscription: Your Online subscription has ended or is paused. Ask your provider to renew it. Nothing is lost: changes are kept and sent after renewal.
Online_Problem_unauthorized: Your provider disconnected this till. Ask for a new link and connect again.
Online_Seal_ConnectNote: Your shop's data is locked on this PC before it is sent. After you connect, you will be shown a recovery code to keep.
Online_Seal_Kept: I printed or saved the recovery code and keep it somewhere safe.
Online_Seal_KeyMissingHelp: Uploading is paused because this PC does not have your key. If this PC replaced an old one, enter the recovery code from your slip. If the slip is lost too, you can make a new key: the old cloud copy then becomes unreadable and your shop is sent again.
Online_Seal_NeedsSlipHelp: Nothing is sent to the cloud yet. Your data will be locked with a key, and you need a copy of that key on paper in case this PC is lost. Show the recovery code, print or save it, then confirm.
Online_Seal_NewKeyMessage: The cloud copy locked with the old key can never be read again. Your shop is sent again with the new key. Nothing on this PC is lost.
Online_Seal_OffHelp: Right now, whoever runs the cloud could read the copy of your shop. Turn on privacy to lock it with a key only you hold. The whole shop is then sent again, locked, and the old readable copy is replaced.
Online_Seal_OnHelp: Your shop's data is locked on this PC before it is sent. Only you can read the cloud copy, with the key kept on this PC and on any phone you link. Your provider cannot.
Online_Seal_ResendNote: When you confirm, the whole shop is sent again, locked. It can take a while on a slow connection. Selling is not affected.
Online_Seal_RestoreHelp: Type the code from your recovery slip. Spaces and dashes do not matter.
Online_Seal_SlipHelp: Keep this in the shop safe. Anyone who has it can read your cloud copy. If this PC is ever lost, it is the only way to get your cloud data back.
Online_Seal_Started: Private Online is on. Your shop is being sent again, locked.
Online_SettingsProblem: The saved Online settings could not be read, so Online is off. Connect again with a new link.
Online_Step1: Ask your provider for your connection link.
Online_Step2: Paste it in the box below.
Online_Step3: Press Connect, then keep the recovery code you are shown. Sending starts once you confirm it.
PrintersLoadFailed: The printer list could not be loaded.
ReceiptFooterMessageHint: Thank you message displayed at the bottom of receipts
ReturnPolicyDaysHint: Number of days for the return policy
ShowSaleComplete: Show the "Sale Complete!" popup after each sale
ShowSaleCompleteHint: When off, the till goes straight back to the next sale and shows a short message instead. The change to hand back is still in that message.

StickerWidthRange: Enter a width from {{min}} to {{max}} mm.
